verdict.rationale: Stripe documents first-party access to an account's current and available balances, offered alongside ACH Direct Debit collection and positioned for risk reduction. A 'balance refresh complete' webhook implies refreshes are asynchronous rather than a synchronous real-time read. One community report also cites a limit to 'only daily pulls', which weakens the 'real-time before payment' part of the story, though it falls short of a concrete contradiction of a documented claim. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented real-time or on-demand balance endpoint with freshness guarantees, documentation of NSF-check use before payment initiation, and independent hands-on corroboration of balance retrieval.
